title: Two-Layer NumPy Network
prompt:
Implement `TwoLayerNet` using only NumPy: two affine layers with ReLU between them and a numerically stable softmax output.

- `__init__(input_dim, hidden_dim, output_dim)`: initialize weights and biases.
- `forward(X)`: return class probabilities of shape `(n_samples, output_dim)`.
- `loss(X, y)`: return mean cross-entropy for integer class labels.
- `train_step(X, y, learning_rate=0.1)`: take one gradient descent step and return the updated loss.

Choose your own initialization and internal implementation.

example.reasoning: A softmax classifier returns one normalized probability row per input example.

interactive_demos.title: Two layers, one gradient at a time
